title: 第5课 · 就买这件吧
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 5 — 就买这件吧 · Take this one

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在家里 — At home

items.zh: A：晚上我们去饭馆吃饭，怎么样？
items.py: A: Wǎnshang wǒmen qù fànguǎn chī fàn, zěnmeyàng?
items.en: A: Shall we go to a restaurant this evening?

items.zh: B：我不想去外面吃，我想在家吃。
items.py: B: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù wàimiàn chī, wǒ xiǎng zài jiā chī.
items.en: B: I don't want to eat out, I want to eat at home.

items.py: A: Nà nǐ zhǔnbèi zuò shénme ne?
items.en: A: Then what are you planning to cook?

items.py: B: Jiù zuò nǐ ài chī de yú ba.
items.en: B: Let's make the fish you love.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在商店 — In a store

items.zh: A：帮我看一下这件衣服怎么样。
items.py: A: Bāng wǒ kàn yíxià zhè jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng.
items.en: A: What do you think of this piece of clothing?

items.zh: B：颜色还可以，就是有点儿大。
items.py: B: Yánsè hái kěyǐ, jiùshì yǒudiǎnr dà.
items.en: B: The colour's OK, but it's a bit big.

items.py: A: Zhè jiàn xiǎo de zěnmeyàng?
items.en: A: What about this smaller one?

items.py: B: Zhè jiàn búcuò, jiù mǎi zhè jiàn ba.
items.en: B: This one's good. Take this one.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.py: A: Jīntiān qù bu qù dǎ qiú?
items.en: A: Are you going to play ball today?

items.zh: B：这两天有点儿累，不去打球了。
items.py: B: Zhè liǎng tiān yǒudiǎnr lèi, bú qù dǎ qiú le.
items.en: B: I've been a bit tired lately, I won't go.

items.zh: A：你在做什么呢？是在想昨天的考试吗？
items.py: A: Nǐ zài zuò shénme ne? Shì zài xiǎng zuótiān de kǎoshì ma?
items.en: A: What are you doing? Thinking about yesterday's exam?

items.zh: B：是啊，我觉得听和说还可以，读和写不好，很多字我都不知道是什么意思。
items.py: B: Shì a, wǒ juéde tīng hé shuō hái kěyǐ, dú hé xiě bù hǎo, hěn duō zì wǒ dōu bù zhīdào shì shénme yìsi.
items.en: B: Yes. Listening and speaking went OK, reading and writing didn't — I didn't know what lots of the characters meant.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在公司 — In the company

items.py: A: Xiūxi yíxià ba, hē kāfēi ma?
items.en: A: Let's take a break. Coffee?

items.zh: B：不喝了，我已经喝两杯了。
items.py: B: Bù hē le, wǒ yǐjīng hē liǎng bēi le.
items.en: B: No thanks, I've already had two cups.

items.zh: A：是啊，咖啡喝多了对身体不好。
items.py: A: Shì a, kāfēi hē duō le duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
items.en: A: Right, too much coffee is bad for you.

items.zh: B：以后我少喝一点儿，每天喝一杯。
items.py: B: Yǐhòu wǒ shǎo hē yìdiǎnr, měi tiān hē yì bēi.
items.en: B: From now on I'll drink less — one cup a day.

items.zh: 你不想去，就在家休息吧。
items.py: Nǐ bù xiǎng qù, jiù zài jiā xiūxi ba.
items.en: If you don't want to go, just rest at home.

items.zh: 这儿的咖啡不错，就喝咖啡吧。
items.py: Zhèr de kāfēi búcuò, jiù hē kāfēi ba.
items.en: The coffee here is good, let's have coffee then.

items.py: Jiù zuò nǐ ài chī de yú ba.
items.en: Let's make the fish you love, then.

items.zh: 颜色还可以，就是有点儿大。
items.py: Yánsè hái kěyǐ, jiùshì yǒudiǎnr dà.
items.en: The colour is OK, it's just a bit big (就是 = only, but).

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (语气副词“还” + Adj: passable)

items.py: Nǐ shēntǐ zěnmeyàng? — Hái hǎo.
items.en: How are you? — Not bad.

items.zh: 这件衣服大吗？——还行，不太大。
items.py: Zhè jiàn yīfu dà ma? — Hái xíng, bú tài dà.
items.en: Is it too big? — It's OK, not too big.

items.zh: 我觉得听和说还可以，读和写不好。
items.py: Wǒ juéde tīng hé shuō hái kěyǐ, dú hé xiě bù hǎo.
items.en: Listening and speaking were OK, reading and writing not.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (有点儿 + Adj: a bit (too))

items.py: Jīntiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng.
items.en: It's a bit cold today.

items.py: Wǒ zuótiān yǒudiǎnr lèi.
items.en: I was a bit tired yesterday.

items.py: Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎnr dà.
items.en: This one is a bit big.

items.zh: 今天晚上他们在哪儿吃饭？
items.py: Jīntiān wǎnshang tāmen zài nǎr chī fàn?
items.en: Where are they eating tonight?

items.zh: 她觉得那件衣服怎么样？
items.py: Tā juéde nà jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng?
items.en: What does she think of that piece of clothing?

items.zh: 她今天为什么不去打球了？
items.py: Tā jīntiān wèi shénme bú qù dǎ qiú le?
items.en: Why isn't she playing ball today?

items.zh: 她觉得昨天的考试怎么样？
items.py: Tā juéde zuótiān de kǎoshì zěnmeyàng?
items.en: What did she think of yesterday's exam?

items.zh: 他为什么以后每天就喝一杯咖啡？
items.py: Tā wèi shénme yǐhòu měi tiān jiù hē yì bēi kāfēi?
items.en: Why will he drink only one coffee a day from now on?

items.zh: 中国人吃饭一般坐圆形餐桌，大家可以面对面。
items.py: Zhōngguórén chī fàn yìbān zuò yuánxíng cānzhuō, dàjiā kěyǐ miàn duì miàn.
items.en: Chinese people usually eat at a round table, so everyone sits face to face.

items.zh: 主人的右手边是主客，左手边是次重要的客人。
items.py: Zhǔrén de yòushǒu biān shì zhǔkè, zuǒshǒu biān shì cì zhòngyào de kèrén.
items.en: The guest of honour sits on the host's right, the second guest on the left.

items.zh: 主人对面上菜的位置一般不给客人坐。
items.py: Zhǔrén duìmiàn shàng cài de wèizhi yìbān bù gěi kèrén zuò.
items.en: The seat opposite the host, where dishes are served, is not offered to guests.

items.zh: 鱼头要对着最主要的客人。
items.py: Yú tóu yào duìzhe zuì zhǔyào de kèrén.
items.en: The fish head points to the most important guest, as a sign of respect.
